Electrification Quirk.name: Electrification Quirk
Electrification Quirk.description:
⚡ You make electricity and release it from your body.

🌱 At the start you stun one adult by touch or shock people within a few steps, with a broad discharge that can also hit allies.
📈 With training: stunning holds, small device charges, absorbed electrical attacks, stronger aimed discharges through conductors or placed targeting gear.
⚠️ You cannot pick distant targets by sight; insulation blocks contact shocks, water and metal spread them, and overload leaves you confused until recovery.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Cognitive Fade, as overloads temporarily scramble your thinking.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Denki Kaminari's Electrification. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Blocking +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Palm Contact Spark, Short Range Flash
🛡️ Resists: electric
Electrification Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: electricity by touch or released around. Start: stun by touch or shock several within a few steps; unaided bursts spread to allies; own body takes normal output. Reach, aim need training, conductive routes or targeting gear.
Limits: finite charge; overuse short-circuits the brain: confused, slow, Quirk unreliable until recovered. Water, metal carry current to others; insulation blocks touch. No aiming by sight; gear markers must be placed first, can be removed. No data or machine control.
Quirk Strain: light: touch, small flash; moderate: sustained hold, device charge, caught electric attack; heavy: directed multi-target discharge; severe: max output, repeated big releases.
Drawback: built in, the canon Cognitive Fade.
Canon: Denki Kaminari's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: user answers for discharges hitting bystanders or wiring, even aimed at villains.
Look: sparks.
